Government increases ONGC chairman entry age to 59, offers longer tenure

The Indian government has raised the entry age for the ONGC chairman position to 59 years. Additionally, the tenure for the role has been extended, allowing for up to five years. This decision impacts the leadership structure of the state-owned oil and gas company.
